fields.subject: Grain Persistence
fields.trigger: the grain key marshaller compiles a new key-mapping, shard-key or default-activation delegate for a grain type
fields.response: when the host logger has Debug enabled, render the compiled expression tree as a debug-view listing and log it with the grain type at Debug under event id ExpressionTreeCreation (1), as CreatedExpressionTreeForDatabaseKey for database-key delegates, CreatedExpressionTreeForShardKey for shard-key delegates, and CreatedExpressionTreeForActivation, with its own activation message text, for the activation delegate
fields.postcondition: with Debug disabled no rendering occurs; each kind of listing is distinguishable by its event name and message
